03
Field Manual

Four rules the Ranger never breaks.

01
Verify out of band
A payment or banking change? Confirm it by calling a number you already trust — never one printed in the message itself.
02
Scopes are the new passwords
Consent phishing needs no password. Treat an OAuth app asking to read your mail and files as seriously as a login prompt.
03
Urgency is the weapon
Pressure plus secrecy is manipulation, not policy. The more a message rushes you, the more it deserves a slow second look.
04
Report, don't just delete
Deleting protects only you. Forwarding to the security team protects everyone the same lure was sent to.
